checkpoint_rule: joint ensemble checkpoint epoch and gate maximize configuration-equal validation mean net gain; ties prefer fewer switches then earlier epoch then lower lambda/threshold; all-rule fallback included
ranking: No automatic promotion; report rule-vs-Base and learning-vs-rule, including failures. S11 development evidence only.
evaluation_cache: reuse unchanged inherited individual when exact chromosome/scenario key is still valid; new constructed solutions are charged, even if an earlier unrelated individual had the same chromosome
primary_report_hv: instance union min/max over final feasible fronts of every method and seed; reference=(1.1,1.1,1.1); reporting only
acceptance: Per component: rule minus Base and learned minus rule must both have positive point estimates; reliable gain additionally requires both paired hierarchical-bootstrap 95% lower bounds > 0; no automatic retraining or PPO
